summary: The repository coherently retires the removed support agent. Current canonical state contains no support-agent declaration, binding, or custom runtime guidance; the patch removes all obsolete canonical assets; and deterministic validation reports a valid repository with zero registered agents and runtimes.

requirements.evidence: Current `moldea/moldea.yaml` contains only version and project-context registration, with no `agents`, `support`, `runtimeAgent`, or custom-runtime entries. The expected obsolete paths `moldea/agents/support/description.md`, `moldea/agents/support/instruction.md`, and `moldea/runtimes/custom.md` are absent. Git diff shows removal of the support manifest registration and `/src/support-agent.ts` binding, deletion of both support model-facing assets, and deletion of guidance claiming the missing `supportAgent` export was runtime-owned. `src/support-agent.ts` is also absent; workspace assertions identify its deletion as pre-existing and actor changes as exactly the four canonical retirement paths. Remaining mentions in `moldea/project.md` and `src/project-state.ts` describe the removal historically rather than claiming current existence. Runner-owned deterministic evidence reports `inspectionStatus: valid`, no failures, passing typecheck, unchanged validation workspace, and zero registered agents/runtimes.
